newsitem.headline: TABLE-Delta Financial Q2 net up before gain.

text.p: Net gain on sale of loans $35,769 $17,800 $18,455 $ 17,697
Pro forma net before item(2) n/a $ 7,075 n/a $ 7,252
NOTE: (1) Includes Fidelity's Mortgage's loan origination points (acquired in February 1997).
(2) Pro forma are as though the company were a C Corp at an assumed effective tax rate of 43%. Delta was an S Corp before October 31, 1996.

(3) Computed by dividing pro forma net income by 10.6 million shares Delta common stock received by former shareholders for their shares of Delta Funding Corp and the effect of the issuance at the IPO price of 1,976,182 shares of Delta common stock to generate sufficient cash to pay certain S corp distribution notes and additional dividends issued in connection with the IPO.
(4) Pro forma presentations for the three months and six months ended June 30, 1996.
